verdict.rationale: Meltano's own pricing page states "Reverse ETL included," and its docs describe loader plugins and connectors that move data "from any source to any destination," so the product claims the capability first-party. That claim is a single thin marketing line, with no documentation of how warehouse models are synced into specific SaaS tools. Missing for 10: documented reverse-ETL workflow from warehouse to SaaS destinations, named CRM/ads/support target connectors, sync semantics such as upserts and field mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I sync modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools (CRM, ads, support) to activate it where teams work

citations.quote: Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination.
your project and pipelines are composed of plugins of different types, most notably extractors, loaders, utilities
